1) the incidence and prevalence of TRH are substantially higher using the new 2017 TRH definition, 2) the new TRH definition is associated with a higher incidence of apparent refractory (RFH) hypertension, and 3) the new TRF definition is associated with higher rates of incident TRH among patients who are treated to a more intensive BP target.
the updated TRH (and apparent refractory hypertension) definitions are expected to increase the incidence and prevalence of TRH and apparent refractory hypertension among hypertensive patients.
the updated definition for TRH will likely increase its prevalence, incidence, and treatment burden in the hypertensive population.
